_note: G0 parity fixture (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-21-play-trails-v1-1.md § 3 G0; brief § 2 rules, § 4 AC 2). Consumed by
backend/test (L3-1) and app/play jvmTest (L1-1): both sides must reproduce, per case, expectInputs from the raw
coverage, then expectNewKeys / expectMarks; and expectTarget / expectClaim per challengeCase. Read-only after G0.
Computed by the Node logic below from the committed data/play/derived/trails.json (quietSegments, quietFeatures,
featureGainM, featurePark, parks), backend/src/data/segments.json (counted segment lengths and trail membership,
generated from the same dataset as data/dist) and data/dist/trails.json (names). Gain in integer decimetres.
A case: input {coverage: {segmentId: coveredM}, completed[] (the sticky completed set), islandWhole};
paidBefore = ledger keys already paid. expectInputs = derive(coverage): nonQuietCoveredM = Σ min(coveredM, length) over
counted segments NOT in derived quietSegments (plan-review ruling: both sides use quietSegments, which includes
segments touching a quiet zone, not only quiet features' segments); touchedTrails = trails with such a covered
segment; touchedParks = their featurePark ∩ parks. nonQuietCoveredM is a float sum: compare within 1e-6 m.
Keys: climb from Σ gain of completed non-quiet trails; high from completed; mile from nonQuietCoveredM; park1 from
touchedParks; parkc from completed; island from islandWhole. expectNewKeys = qualifying − paidBefore, sorted.
Fixture invariant: a completed trail has full coverage of all its counted segments in `coverage`.
A challengeCase (D5): target = min(default, remaining(completed) + progress); climb in dm, parks as distinct Play
Data-derived truths that differ from the brief's wording: no trail has gain 40.0 / 39.9 exactly (Trillium 40.4 is
the lowest steep trail, Sound to Olympics 38.7 the highest non-steep); 'climb 99.9 / 100.0' are sums of real
no-park trails under 40 m; AC 2's '1,609 m → 1 mi' is read as 1,609.344 m (D6); the island's counted metres outside
quietSegments are 102008.8 m, not the brief's 102,964 m (that figure used the server's quiet-feature-only set).
const touchedParks = [...new Set(touchedTrails.map((t) => parkOf[t]).filter((p) => p && parks.has(p)))].sort();
function qualifying({ nonQuietCoveredM, touchedParks }, completed, islandWhole) {
const done = [...new Set(completed)].filter((t) => t in gainDm && !quietFeatures.has(t));
const climb = done.reduce((a, t) => a + gainDm[t], 0);
for (const m of CLIMB_STEPS_M) if (climb >= m * 10) keys.add(`climb:${m}`);
for (const t of done) if (gainDm[t] >= STEEP_DM) keys.add(`high:${t}`);
for (const mi of MILE_STEPS) if (mi <= miles + EPS) keys.add(`mile:${mi}`);
return { climb: "climb", high: "high_ground", mile: "milestone", park1: "park_first", parkc: "park_complete", island: "island" }[p];
const marks = { climb: 0, high_ground: 0, milestone: 0, park_first: 0, park_complete: 0, island: 0 };
for (const k of newKeys) marks[kindOf(k)] += MARKS[kindOf(k)];
const remaining = Object.keys(gainDm).filter((t) => !quietFeatures.has(t) && !c.has(t)).reduce((a, t) => a + gainDm[t], 0);
for (const t of Object.keys(parkOf)) if (!quietFeatures.has(t) && parks.has(parkOf[t]) && !c.has(t)) remaining.add(parkOf[t]);

const MARKS = {"climb":50,"high_ground":50,"milestone":50,"park_first":50,"park_complete":150,"island":1000}; CLIMB_STEPS_M = [100,250,500,750,1000,1250]; MILE_STEPS = [1,5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40,45,50,55,60]; STEEP_DM = 400; METRES_PER_MILE = 1609.344; EPS = 1e-9
